from mw_runtime import Session
s=Session(); s.move([.021,.90,.08],gripper=-1,steps=60); s.move([.021,.90,.025],gripper=-1,steps=45)
for y in [.87,.83,.79,.75,.71,.68]: s.move([.021,y,.025],gripper=-1,steps=30)
s.move([.021,.70,.12],gripper=-1,steps=45)
s.move([-.035,.71,.12],gripper=-1,steps=45)
s.move([-.035,.71,.025],gripper=-1,steps=35)
for x in [-.01,.02,.05,.09,.12]:
 s.move([x,.71,.025],gripper=-1,steps=25)
 if s.result()['success']: break
print('result',s.result())
print('obj',s.observe()['bodies']['obj']['position'])
s.save('/app/output/trajectory.npz')
